transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to get next week's sustainment-training board finalized and published by 1600 today. The board needs to include the driver-certification block and the radio-procedures refresher for support personnel. Before I sign off on the final board, I need the S-3 and motor pool chief to report any schedule or readiness changes at our weekly training huddle. What do we need to adjust?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to report a schedule change. I received a higher-headquarters tasking this morning requiring 2nd Platoon to complete a radio-procedures refresher on Wednesday from 1300 to 1500, with an attendance roster submitted afterward. The tasking is still being entered into the battalion training tracker and is not yet on the briefing slide, so we need to make sure it gets added to the board before you sign.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to report a readiness change. During this morning's inspection, I confirmed that only four of our six assigned training trucks have completed brake inspections. The other two will not be released until Friday at 0800. This inspection status has not yet been posted to the training board, so we need to account for it before you sign off — especially since the driver-certification block is normally scheduled for Tuesday morning and we'd only have four trucks available that day.
transcript.speaker: A3

decisions.driver_certification_window: Tuesday morning, with only four trucks available

commitments.detail: Add the Wednesday 1300-1500 radio-procedures refresher for 2nd Platoon to the training board and submit the attendance roster afterward.
Annotate on the training board that only four training trucks are available for Tuesday's driver-certification block; the remaining two will be released Friday at 0800.
Sign and publish the finalized sustainment-training board by 1600 today after both updates are incorporated.
